description: Enhanced source end-to-end cases across languages: a Rust function name typo, Python comment + function-name typos, a JavaScript function-name typo, and a TOML string-value typo while numeric literals are ignored. Each misspelling is reported as its UTF-8 start byte offset within the whole input, end byte offset, and text, one per line, ordered by position. The request is {"op":"spellcheck","text":<source>,"lang":<id>}.
